messages:
oncall-bot: PAGER: KV_CACHE_BLOWUP alert for service=rope-kv in prod-us-west-2. eviction_rate > 95%, continuous-batching backlog rising. severity=P1. link: https://redwood.tools/incidents/2150012345

Priya (SRE): ack — I’m taking this. seeing huge eviction spikes and batch growth on routes with long-context turned on.

Diego (runtime): quick triage: NTK token-tracking + YaRN sliding-window metrics show prefix cardinality explosion. continuous batching is coalescing many small requests into large KV fanout.

Sam (oncall): any immediate customer impact numbers?

Priya (SRE): yes — ~7% 5xx on generation endpoints for affected routes, 99p latency ~2.2s up from ~200ms. support lists 4 tenants with heavy long-context traffic impacted.

Maya (support): opened priority tickets for AcmeCorp and NovaLabs. Both see timeouts and request ETA. I've asked them to temporarily shorten context while we investigate.

Diego (runtime): preparing hotfix to force smaller batching and disable yarn sliding-window for generation routes. patch draft below:

```
# hotfix payload (admin API)
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/api/v1/runtime/hotpatch \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \
  -d '{"route_pattern":"/v1/generate*","ops":[
    {"set":"batch.window_ms","value":10},
    {"set":"batch.max_tokens","value":128},
    {"set":"features.yarn_sliding_window","value":false}
  ]}'
```

Priya (SRE): applying to prod-us-west-2 as 10% canary now. monitoring dashboards up.

oncall-bot: deploybot: rollout started for hotpatch id=hf-2026-03-15-001 (canary=10%).

Sam (oncall): enabling interim kv eviction throttle for rope routes: `kv.eviction_rate_limit=0.2` (cluster-level).

Diego (runtime): canary reports: eviction rate down ~60% within 3m, 99p latency dropped to ~420ms, 5xx down to ~1.2% on canary nodes.

Priya (SRE): increasing canary to 50% in 5m. if stable, push global.

Maya (support): Sent customer update: "We identified an interaction between long-context routing + sliding-window caching. A mitigation is rolling out; ETA ~20m." AcmeCorp acknowledged :thumbsup:.

Eve (product): Do we need a global rollback of long-context features or per-tenant disable?

Diego (runtime): short-term: yarn sliding-window disabled globally in the hotpatch and batching caps applied. medium-term: implement adaptive KV-cardinality limits per tenant + early-abort when prefix fanout > X.

Priya (SRE): confirming we will keep yarn disabled until follow-up change. scaling mitigation across all prod clusters now. Oncall handoff: Sam will take over at 04:00 UTC if still open.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — severity=P1, affected_tenants=4, mitigation steps applied: batch window cap, batch token cap, yarn disabled, kv throttle. runbook: rope-kv > continuous-batching > mitigation.

Sam (oncall): taking handoff. Priya, Diego — thanks. I’ll coordinate post-mit items and RCA.

Priya (SRE): handing off. operational notes and commands saved in /runbooks/incidents/2150012345.md.

Sam (oncall): monitoring for 30m; if stable, will file postmortem and schedule RCA with runtime within 48h.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — mitigation successful. time_to_mitigate=12m. followups: RCA + tenant-level safeguards + automated early-abort for extreme KV fanout.
